entities.name: Fernando Tatís
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fernando Gabriel Tatís Medina Sr. is a Dominican former professional baseball third baseman who currently serves as the manager for the Algodoneros de Unión Laguna of the Mexican League. Over his 11-year Major League Baseball (MLB) career, Tatís played for the Texas Rangers, St. Louis Cardinals, Montreal Expos, Baltimore Orioles, and New York Mets. He holds the major league record for runs batted in (RBI) in an inning, a feat that he achieved by hitting two grand slams in one inning during a game on April 23, 1999, becoming the only player in MLB history to do so.
